top_choice_rationale: P001 is a complete and mature achievement: proglucagon processing and the incretin effect (Holst, Drucker) and identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov) underlie incretin therapies with large randomized effects on glycemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes, and the mechanism has been confirmed independently for about three decades. The three-person allocation and citation scope are defensible, though omitting Habener and Knudsen is a judgment on priority and is not a settled finding. No award is clearly inferior to this achievement.
